metadata.issued_by: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)

definitions.aggregator: Entity providing digital platform for transportation services (as per MV Act Sec 2(1A)).
definitions.apportioned_fare: Part of fare retained by aggregator.
definitions.driver_fare: Part of fare payable to driver (includes toll/parking paid by driver).
definitions.dynamic_pricing: Fare algorithm output raising price when demand > supply.
definitions.fare: Total charges payable by passenger (includes toll, tax, parking).
definitions.journey: Trip undertaken or not, from departure to destination.
definitions.licence: Licence issued under Section 93 of MV Act.
definitions.rating: Assessment of journey quality based on aggregator parameters.
definitions.security_deposit: Amount payable by aggregator (bank guarantee/insurance surety bond).

applicability.applies_to: Any aggregator operating within a State.
exemptions: Entities providing only interoperable network (no direct onboarding)
Entities engaged in sale of tickets for public service vehicles

application.portal: Designated Portal (Central Govt) / State Govt until portal ready

tiers.vehicles: Up to 100 buses OR 1000 other MV
Up to 1000 buses OR 10000 other MV

conditionsforlicence.commencement_intimation: Written intimation to Competent Authority; update within 6 months of licence grant.
conditionsforlicence.precommencementnotice: 72 hours prior to commencement, intimate authority + upload on portal.
conditionsforlicence.healthsafetyguidelines: Follow Central/State Govt health/public safety guidelines.
conditionsforlicence.multiaggregatorpolicy: Cannot prohibit/restrict drivers from operating with multiple aggregators.
conditionsforlicence.rating_mechanism: App must allow both driver and passenger to rate journey experience.
conditionsforlicence.permit_compliance: Must onboard vehicles with valid contract carriage permit.
conditionsforlicence.past_cancellation: Licence should not have been cancelled in past 1 year.

grievance_officer.duties: Resolve grievances, provide details to Competent Authority online
grievance_officer.visibility: Name, email, phone on App and website

curriculum: First responder training (min 6 hours) for emergencies/accidents
Careful driving, traffic rules, MV maintenance, fuel efficiency, conduct
induction_training.portal_upload: Training structure details must be uploaded on designated portal.

onboarding_conditions: Valid driving licence for vehicle type/class throughout onboarding
Valid bank account in driver's name
No conviction in past 3 years for: DUI/drugs, cognizable offences under BNS 2023/BNSS 2023 (fraud, sexual offences, MV used for crime, property damage/theft, violence, terror, nuisance/danger)
Medical examination (fitness + eye check) by identified hospital/institution
Psychological analysis by aggregator to determine fitness
Police verification of character/antecedents (min 7 days prior to onboarding) + written record
Valid contract executed (in State language) specifying terms; standard terms available online
welfare_conditions: Health insurance: Min Rs. 5 Lakh per driver (increase % as notified by Central Govt)
Term insurance: Min Rs. 10 Lakh per driver (increase % as notified by Central Govt)
Social Security Code 2020 prevails upon notification/implementation
Annual Refresher Training (in-person + virtual); maintain records
Bottom 5 percentile rated drivers: Compulsory quarterly refresher training (else off-boarded)
Complaint inquiry: Within 3 days of registration; action only after inquiry; inform passenger of outcome
digital_records: Two emergency contacts (name, address, contact info)

conditions: Valid registration
Valid Certificate of Fitness (MV Act)
Display registration mark (CMVR)
Valid third-party insurance
Valid PUC certificate (CMVR 1989)
State/urban emission norms
City-specific fuel norms
Paid applicable MV taxes/dues
No unpaid challans for offences/contraventions under MV Act
Display copy of driver's licence + MV permit (if applicable) inside vehicle (back of front seat next to driver, visible to passengers) — except motorcycles
Functional VLTD/VLTS (AIS 140 compliant) + panic button (CMVR Rule 125H) connected to aggregator control room + State/UT integrated command centre
Disabled child lock mechanism (except 3-wheelers, motorcycles, buses)
Manual override for central locking (except 3-wheelers, motorcycles, buses)
Fire extinguisher (suitable capacity) inside vehicle (except motorcycles)
First-aid kit inside vehicle

age_limit.rule: Cannot onboard vehicles registered > 8 years ago; ensure all onboarded vehicles do not exceed 8 years since initial registration.

verification_records: Pending e-challans count prior to onboarding + clearance before onboarding

app_requirements: Accessible in English, Hindi, + official State/UT language (if not Hindi)
Cyber safety certified by CERT-In empaneled firm
Data generation/storage on App per DPDP Act 2023
Disclosure of fare share proportion, incentives, driver fare, apportioned fare (as notified by State Govt) on website + App
Live location sharing feature for passengers (until journey completion)
Clear high-resolution picture of onboarded driver
Zero-tolerance policy for drugs/alcohol use by drivers on duty (upload policy + complaint procedure on website/App; immediate off-boarding pending inquiry upon complaint)
Driver contact info available to passenger for min 7 days post-journey
24x7 control room monitoring all onboarded vehicles (uninterrupted contact)
24x7 call centre (active phone + email on website/App) in English + State official language for journey/driver issues + grievance redressal
Cooperation with lawfully authorised authorities investigating accidents/incidents

conditions: VLTD/VLTS functioning properly + feed received + linked to State integrated Command Control Centre (includes in-App tracking for all MV including motorcycles/3-wheelers)
Driver follows App-indicated route; deviation signals control room → immediate connection with driver + passenger
Safety of passengers (especially children, women, divyangjan) + applicable law compliance ensured
App mechanism to verify driver identity matches police-verified onboarded identity
Regular checks by authorized personnel of onboarded vehicles

non_discrimination.policy: Treat driver-owned/third-party-provided vehicles at parity with aggregator-owned vehicles.

base_fare.source: State Govt notified fare for respective category/class
base_fare.covers: Dead mileage (distance without passenger + pickup distance/fuel)

driver_share.other_scenarios: As per agreement between driver and aggregator

undeterminedfarestates.rule: Aggregator may notify base fare to State Govt; followed until State determines fare

deadmileagecharge.rule: No charge except when ride availment distance < 3 km
deadmileagecharge.fare_calculation: Only from journey origin to destination drop-off point

by_passenger.distribution: Divided between driver and aggregator in same proportion as Clause 17 (fare regulation)

penalty_deduction.rule: Penalty (Clause 18) deducted from respective share (Clause 17) of driver or aggregator.

sustainable_fleet.rule: State Govt may direct incremental annual increase in % of electric/alternate fuel/zero emission vehicles.

divyangjan_fleet.rule: State Govt determines adequate number of Divyangjan-friendly MVs; directs aggregators to proportionately include in fleet.

electricmobilityconversion.rule: Mandatory adherence to EV inclusion targets fixed by appropriate Govt/air quality regulator/State Govt.

permissions: State Govt may allow aggregation of non-transport motorcycles for passenger journeys (shared mobility, reduced congestion/pollution, affordable mobility, hyperlocal delivery, livelihood)
State Govt may permit under MV Act Sec 67(3)
State Govt may impose fees for authorizations (daily/weekly/fortnightly basis)
Onboarding must satisfy all guideline compliances

grounds: Failure to ensure passenger/driver safety (including via quarterly rating parameter analysis)
Frequent fare issues: unjustified dynamic pricing, non-compliance with fare division guidelines, unsubstantiated charges on drivers
Failure to comply with driver contract obligations
Safety standard violations resulting in road accidents
Severity of financial irregularities (via account audit)
Other parameters deemed fit by Competent Authority

procedure.alternative_penalty: Rs. 1 Lakh to Rs. 1 Crore (if suspension not expedient/feasible)

post_suspension.immediate_stop: All operations under Licence until revocation/period ends
post_suspension.undertaking: Before expiry, written undertaking that suspension grounds resolved
post_suspension.acknowledgement_order: Competent Authority passes order acknowledging resolution + undertaking receipt

probationary_period.rule: Resume operations; ensure compliance; infractions during this period may lead directly to cancellation (Clause 25)

cancellation_grounds: Licence suspended within 3 financial years + another infraction under Clause 24
Violation of grievous nature endangering passenger/driver safety/security

procedure.decision: Reasoned order; bring to notice of other States + Central Govt

voluntary_surrender.rule: May surrender at any time; Security Deposit returned after deducting outstanding dues

appeal.authority: Notified appellate authority designated by State Govt
appeal.form: Memorandum disclosing grounds + requisite fee + copy of impugned order

stategovtpowers.information_call: Written notice to call for information/documents/records to ensure compliance; includes power to conduct inquiry
stategovtpowers.authentication_enablement: Enable aggregator to authenticate onboarded vehicles/drivers/owners via VAHAN and SARATHI portals

form_i.title: Application for Grant of Licence
fields: Number/type of vehicles proposed + separate list (vehicle numbers + permit particulars)
Returns filed last 3 financial years (financial statements)

form_ii.title: Application for Renewal of Licence
fields: Number/type of vehicles proposed + separate list

form_iii.title: Licence for Aggregator
fields: Number of auto rickshaw/e-rickshaw/motor cab/motorcycle/bus (per enclosed list)

pramaanintegrationnotes.usage: This JSON serves as the 'Official Rule' source for the Pramaan Engine when auditing Gig Payslips, Aggregator Terms of Service, or Driver Contracts.

matching_strategy.faresharecheck: Match 'Driver Payout' on payslip against Clause 17.4 (min 80% for driver-owned) or 17.5 (min 60% for aggregator-owned). Flag if below threshold.
matching_strategy.dynamicpricingcheck: Match 'Surge Multiplier' against Clause 17.3 (max 2x base fare). Flag if exceeds.
matching_strategy.deadmileagecheck: Match 'Pickup Charge' against Clause 17.8 (no charge unless ride < 3km). Flag unauthorized dead mileage charges.
matching_strategy.cancellationfeecheck: Match 'Cancellation Fee' against Clause 18 (max 10% of fare, capped at Rs. 100). Flag excess.
matching_strategy.insurance_check: Match 'Driver Insurance' coverage against Clause 11.2 (Health min 5L, Term min 10L). Flag if missing/below.
matching_strategy.vehicleagecheck: Match 'Vehicle Registration Date' against Clause 13.2 (max 8 years). Flag if exceeded.
matching_strategy.multiaggregatorcheck: Match 'Exclusivity Clause' in driver contract against Clause 9.6 (cannot restrict multi-aggregator operation). Flag exclusivity clauses as illegal.
matching_strategy.grievanceofficercheck: Verify presence of Grievance Officer details (name, email, phone) on App/website per Clause 9.10. Flag absence.
matching_strategy.training_check: Verify 'Induction Training' completion record against Clause 10 (min 40 hours). Flag if missing.
matching_strategy.safetydevicecheck: Verify 'Panic Button + VLTD' presence against Clause 13.1(xi). Flag absence.
